biography: Cameron 'The Celtic Cyclone' Davies hails from the rugged coast of Wales, a landscape that seems to have forged his aggressive and uncompromising driving style. Unlike many who start in karting, Davies' racing journey began late, at 19, after winning a local hill climb in a battered Ford Escort. The raw talent was undeniable. He quickly ascended the ranks of Formula Ford and Formula 3, attracting attention with his fearless overtaking maneuvers and uncanny ability to extract speed from seemingly underperforming machinery. A defining moment came at the 2017 Brands Hatch Formula 3 race, where he took victory from the back of the grid after a first-lap incident, showcasing both his pace and his tenacity. Now in his prime, Davies pilots the MCR S2000, consistently challenging for podiums and race wins, proving he's a force to be reckoned with.
drivingStyle: Davies is known for his relentlessly aggressive driving style, often pushing his car and tires to the absolute limit. He's a late-braking specialist, unafraid to dive down the inside of corners, even if it means a slight rub of paint. While this occasionally leads to incidents, it also allows him to pull off spectacular overtakes. Tire management isn't his strongest suit; he prefers flat-out speed to meticulous conservation. Under pressure, Davies tends to thrive, relishing the challenge of a close battle and rarely cracking under the strain.

careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2022 Monaco Grand Prix due to overconfidence, costing him a likely victory and significant championship points.
